## dream-team

Show dream team

```text
Usage: fplr dream-team [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -g, --gw <GW>   Specific Gameweek (defaults to current)
```

**Example**

```sh
fplr dream-team
```

## live

Show live player stats for a specific event

```text
Usage: fplr live [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -g, --gw <GW>        Specific Gameweek (defaults to current)
  -l, --limit <LIMIT>  [default: 20]
```

**Example**

```sh
fplr live -l 10
```

## table

Show league table

```text
Usage: fplr table [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -l, --live      Include matches currently in play
```

```sh
fplr table
```
